peg_reference.notes: GHO targets one U.S. dollar through Aave DAO-governed facilitator capacity, borrowing demand, liquidity, and stability modules.

valuation_source.label: GHO market price and DAO-governed stability mechanisms

yield_or_rebase_profile.notes: GHO balances do not rebase; borrowing interest is paid by debt positions.

classification_notes: Aave-native facilitator-issued stablecoin. Borrower repayment, GSM conversion, canonical bridging, and secondary-market exit are distinct mechanisms.

peg_reference.notes: BOLD targets one U.S. dollar through immutable Liquity V2 borrowing, redemption, interest-rate, and Stability Pool mechanics.

valuation_source.label: BOLD market price and direct collateral redemption

yield_or_rebase_profile.notes: BOLD itself does not rebase. Stability Pool or third-party sBOLD positions are separate yield-bearing layers.

classification_notes: Ethereum-native Liquity V2 stablecoin backed by WETH, wstETH, and rETH branches. It is distinct from LUSD and third-party sBOLD.

peg_reference.notes: USD0 is designed for 1:1 minting and redemption against eligible short-duration tokenized sovereign assets or supported indirect collateral routes.

valuation_source.label: Usual RWA aggregator, collateral providers, and protocol accounting

yield_or_rebase_profile.notes: USD0 itself is the stable settlement asset. bUSD0, sUSD0, and USD0a are separate yield or strategy products.

classification_notes: RWA-backed protocol stablecoin. Direct primary-market redemption and indirect USDC routing have different eligibility and minimum-size conditions.

peg_reference.notes: USR is designed to maintain a one-dollar value through liquid collateral, diversified allocation, and an RLP first-loss layer.

valuation_source.label: Resolv collateral accounting, oracle-priced mint and burn requests, and market price

yield_or_rebase_profile.notes: USR is not treated as the yield-bearing receipt. stUSR and wstUSR are separate staking representations.

classification_notes: Restricted after the March 2026 unauthorized-mint incident. USR, RLP, stUSR, and wstUSR remain separate asset identities.
